== Build notes ==
Date-block samples for Template:Card/sandbox, swccg-guild/work#597. Released is evergreen. Remastered only on remaster samples. Blanked only on the version that was cut. Retired is slot reuse. Live Template:Card not swapped.

== Date examples ==
The [[SWCCG Wiki:Card date sample/Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1 Remastered 2006)|Luke VS1 example]] retains Released and omits the separate Remastered date. The [[SWCCG Wiki:Card date sample/Clumsy And Stupid (Errata 2)|Clumsy And Stupid example]] shows Blanked, and the [[SWCCG Wiki:Card date sample/Imperial Justice (V) (Virtual Set 0)|Imperial Justice example]] shows Retired, matching their current articles. The [[SWCCG Wiki:Card date sample/2-1B (Remastered)|2-1B example]] shows Released and Remastered for the [[:File:RG-GEMP-2-1B.png|remastered output image]] by 28 October 2026.
